src/Cluckwork.Api/Cli/BootstrapAdminCliC.name: Create first admin

src/Cluckwork.Api/Cli/RenameAccountCliCo.name: Rename farm code command

src/Cluckwork.Api/Cli/SeedCliCommand.cs.name: Load sample data command
src/Cluckwork.Api/Cli/SeedCliCommand.cs.description: Command seed: updates the database, loads a chosen set of demo or test data and exits.
